title: Six closure properties of the quasi-coherent modules on a big site
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a scheme S and a topology among Zariski, etale, smooth, syntomic, fppf, the lemma lists six closure properties of the category of quasi-coherent modules on the big site of S: direct sums, arbitrary colimits, cokernels, the middle term of a short exact sequence whose outer terms are quasi-coherent, tensor products, and internal homs with a finite locally free first argument (statement lines 3514-3539). The proof is one uniform transfer: the equivalence of quasi-coherent modules on the big site with quasi-coherent modules on S, given by pullback along the structure maps, commutes with each of the six constructions in turn, and each of the six facts then holds because the corresponding fact holds for quasi-coherent modules on the scheme S (proof lines 3542-3545). Five of the six parts are one line each precisely because that commutation is all that is needed (proof lines 3548-3560, 3563-3568, 3571-3575, 3578-3585), while part (6) adds a Zariski local reduction that the author marks as omitted details (proof lines 3588-3596). The claim is H2: the substance is the identification of each of the six constructions as the construction on S followed by the big-site pullback, and no part requires more than that, so this is a complete but routine derivation and not one of the multi-argument or extra-criterion cases.
